blocks.zh: 先進治療藥品製造規範：品質管制、特定產品類型與術語彙編
blocks.en: Manufacture of Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products: Quality Control, Specific Product Types and Glossary

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ATMP 品質管制（QC）的特殊挑戰：樣品稀缺性、短效期放行、分散式製造的批次認證流程
blocks.en: Understand the particular QC challenges of ATMPs: scarce samples, short shelf-life release, and the batch certification process in decentralised manufacture

blocks.zh: 掌握第七章外包活動與第八章產品回收的 ATMP 特定要求，包含「look-back」程序
blocks.en: Master the ATMP-specific requirements of Chapter 7 (outsourced activities) and Chapter 8 (product recall), including the "look-back" procedure

blocks.zh: 辨識 Part B 各特定產品類型（動物來源、基因治療、細胞療法、組織工程）的額外控制要求
blocks.en: Recognise the additional control requirements for each specific product type in Part B (animal-derived, gene therapy, cell therapy, tissue-engineered)

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Annex 2A 術語彙編中的核心定義，能在 CDMO 作業情境下正確應用 MCB、WCB、viral vector、scaffold 等關鍵術語
blocks.en: Become familiar with the core definitions in the Annex 2A glossary, and apply key terms such as MCB, WCB, viral vector and scaffold correctly in CDMO scenarios

blocks.zh: Chapter 5（續）— 起始物料管理：供應商、人體血液/組織與種子批/細胞庫
blocks.en: Chapter 5 (continued) - Starting Material Management: Suppliers, Human Blood/Tissue, and Seed Lots/Cell Banks

blocks.zh: 解析：起始物料管理的 ATMP 特殊性
blocks.en: Commentary: What Is Special About Starting Material Management for ATMPs

blocks.zh: PRP（Product Risk Profile）驅動的供應商管理
blocks.en: PRP (Product Risk Profile)-Driven Supplier Management

blocks.zh: PRP 是 ATMP 特有概念：依 QRM 評估將每種起始物料定義為低/中/高風險，決定 GMP 控制深度。高風險物料（如細胞來源的原材料）需要正式品質協議；低風險物料的要求可以相應降低。
blocks.en: The PRP is a concept specific to ATMPs: each starting material is defined as low, medium or high risk based on QRM assessment, which determines the depth of GMP control. High-risk materials (for example, raw materials of cell origin) require a formal quality agreement; requirements for low-risk materials can be reduced accordingly.

blocks.zh: CDMO 操作意涵：客戶帶來 ATMP 專案時，必須提供每種起始物料的風險評估文件，CDMO 再依此建立供應商審核計畫。
blocks.en: CDMO implications: When a client brings an ATMP project, they must provide a risk assessment document for each starting material, and the CDMO then builds its supplier audit programme on that basis.

blocks.zh: 無法終端滅菌 → 無菌製程更重要
blocks.en: Terminal sterilisation is not possible, so aseptic processing matters more

blocks.zh: ATMP 通常含有活細胞或對熱敏感的生物分子，不能像小分子藥物一樣進行終端滅菌。這意味著整個製程的無菌保障（aseptic assurance）成為產品安全的核心支柱，而不是最後的「補救措施」。
blocks.en: ATMPs usually contain living cells or heat-sensitive biomolecules and cannot be terminally sterilised the way small-molecule drugs can. This means aseptic assurance across the entire process becomes the core pillar of product safety, rather than a last "remedial measure".

blocks.zh: 比喻：Single Use Systems 的角色
blocks.en: Analogy: The Role of Single Use Systems

blocks.zh: 單次性使用系統（一次性袋子、管路、反應槽）在 ATMP 中幾乎不可或缺——它們大幅降低交叉污染風險。但 GMP 要求這些系統的供應商也需被納入合格供應商管理，就像傳統不鏽鋼設備的維護一樣嚴謹。
blocks.en: Single-use systems (disposable bags, tubing, bioreactors) are almost indispensable in ATMP manufacture, because they greatly reduce the risk of cross-contamination. However, GMP requires the suppliers of these systems to be included in qualified supplier management, with the same rigour as the maintenance of traditional stainless steel equipment.

blocks.zh: 解析：人體組織作為起始物料
blocks.en: Commentary: Human Tissue as a Starting Material

blocks.zh: 「Chain of Custody」的法規意義
blocks.en: The Regulatory Meaning of "Chain of Custody"

blocks.zh: 人體血液與組織在法律上受「捐血/組織捐贈法規」監管，與一般化學原料完全不同。供應商不只是商業廠商，而是持有國家主管機關許可的「血液庫/組織庫」。ATMP 製造商必須驗證這些機構的許可狀態。
blocks.en: Human blood and tissue are regulated by law under blood/tissue donation regulations, which is completely different from ordinary chemical raw materials. The supplier is not just a commercial vendor but a "blood establishment/tissue establishment" holding a licence from the national competent authority. ATMP manufacturers must verify the licence status of these establishments.

blocks.zh: RP（Responsible Person）的角色
blocks.en: The Role of the RP (Responsible Person)

blocks.zh: 組織庫的 RP 相當於製造端的 Authorised Person（AP）。組織庫 RP 放行後，起始物料才能離開組織庫進入 ATMP 製程。這是雙重放行架構——組織庫 RP 放行原料，ATMP 廠的 AP 最終放行成品。
blocks.en: The RP of a tissue establishment is equivalent to the Authorised Person (AP) on the manufacturing side. The starting material may leave the tissue establishment and enter the ATMP process only after release by the tissue establishment RP. This is a dual-release structure: the tissue establishment RP releases the raw material, and the AP of the ATMP manufacturer finally releases the finished product.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：接收人體組織的標準程序
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Standard Procedure for Receiving Human Tissue

blocks.zh: 當客戶的自體細胞（autologous cells）由醫院採集後送到 CDMO：
blocks.en: When a client's autologous cells are collected at a hospital and sent to the CDMO:

blocks.zh: 確認是否有組織庫 RP 的放行文件
blocks.en: Confirm that the tissue establishment RP release documentation is available

blocks.zh: 確認運輸條件（冷鏈溫度記錄）是否符合書面協議
blocks.en: Confirm that transport conditions (cold chain temperature records) comply with the written agreement

blocks.zh: 在成品放行前確保捐者身份與收受者 ID 的可追溯鏈完整
blocks.en: Before finished product release, ensure that the traceability chain between donor identity and recipient ID is complete

blocks.zh: 進口組織需符合本地等效法規標準
blocks.en: Imported tissue must meet locally equivalent regulatory standards

blocks.zh: 解析：細胞庫系統的 GMP 建立
blocks.en: Commentary: Establishing a GMP Cell Bank System

blocks.zh: MCB / WCB 兩層系統的邏輯
blocks.en: The Logic of the Two-Tier MCB / WCB System

blocks.zh: MCB（Master Cell Bank）是最終主庫，一旦建立幾乎不動。WCB（Working Cell Bank）從 MCB 衍生，用於日常生產。這種分層確保即使 WCB 耗盡或出問題，仍可從 MCB 重新建立新的 WCB，產品品質不中斷。
blocks.en: The MCB (Master Cell Bank) is the ultimate master bank and, once established, is almost never touched. The WCB (Working Cell Bank) is derived from the MCB and used for routine production. This tiering ensures that even if the WCB is exhausted or has a problem, a new WCB can be re-established from the MCB, so product quality is not interrupted.

blocks.zh: MCB（主細胞庫）
blocks.en: MCB (Master Cell Bank)

blocks.zh: WCB（工作細胞庫）
blocks.en: WCB (Working Cell Bank)

blocks.zh: 生產批次（Production Batch）
blocks.en: Production Batch

blocks.zh: 自體 ATMP 的不同之處
blocks.en: How Autologous ATMPs Differ

blocks.zh: 自體產品沒有標準 MCB/WCB 系統，每位患者即是一個獨立的起始物料來源。法規改以「cell stock」概念管理，且代次（passage number）限制必須寫入 CTA/MA。
blocks.en: Autologous products have no standard MCB/WCB system; each patient is an independent source of starting material. Regulators instead manage this through the "cell stock" concept, and the passage number limit must be written into the CTA/MA.

blocks.zh: 比喻：液氮氣相儲存
blocks.en: Analogy: Liquid Nitrogen Vapour Phase Storage

blocks.zh: 「vapor phase」（氣相）比「液相」更安全，因為液態氮直接浸泡可能造成容器間的微生物污染傳播（若封裝不完整）。氣相儲存溫度仍低達 -150°C 以下，同樣有效保存細胞活性。這是現行業界標準做法。
blocks.en: "Vapour phase" is safer than "liquid phase", because direct immersion in liquid nitrogen may transmit microbial contamination between containers (if the closure is not intact). Vapour phase storage temperature is still below -150°C and preserves cell viability equally well. This is the current industry standard practice.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：細胞庫管理要點
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Key Points of Cell Bank Management

blocks.zh: 細胞庫建立期間，同一空間/人員不得同時處理其他活性生物材料
blocks.en: During cell bank establishment, the same space/personnel must not handle other live biological materials at the same time

blocks.zh: 液氮槽需連續監控溫度，偏差需記錄 CAPA
blocks.en: Liquid nitrogen tanks require continuous temperature monitoring, and deviations must be recorded with CAPA

blocks.zh: 庫存必須分存於不同地點以防全損（disaster recovery 概念）
blocks.en: Inventory must be stored at separate locations to prevent total loss (a disaster recovery concept)

blocks.zh: 從細胞庫取出的容器不可放回庫存
blocks.en: A container removed from the cell bank must not be returned to storage

blocks.zh: Chapter 6 — 品質管制（Quality Control）
blocks.en: Chapter 6 - Quality Control

blocks.zh: 解析：ATMP QC 的特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Commentary: Special QC Challenges for ATMPs

blocks.zh: 「In-process controls 更重要」的理由
blocks.en: Why "In-Process Controls Matter More"

blocks.zh: 傳統製劑（如注射劑）可以在成品完成後進行完整的品質放行測試，但 ATMP 往往因為：
blocks.en: For conventional dosage forms (such as injectables), full quality release testing can be performed once the finished product is complete, but for ATMPs this is often not possible because:

blocks.zh: 成品量極少（自體治療，一批=一位患者）
blocks.en: The quantity of finished product is extremely small (autologous therapy: one batch = one patient)

blocks.zh: 效期極短（數小時到數天）
blocks.en: Shelf-life is extremely short (hours to days)

blocks.zh: 最終測試結果回報前產品已需給藥
blocks.en: The product must be administered before the final test results are reported

blocks.zh: 因此製程中的控制成為保障品質的核心，而非最終放行測試。
blocks.en: In-process controls therefore become the core of quality assurance, rather than final release testing.

blocks.zh: 自體產品的身份確認義務
blocks.en: Identity Confirmation Obligations for Autologous Products

blocks.zh: QC 主管的責任清單中明確包含：確認起始物料的來源患者與最終接受者一致。這是 ATMP 特有的「身份比對」要求，一般藥廠不需要做這件事。錯誤給藥（wrong patient）在細胞治療中是潛在致命事件。
blocks.en: The QC head's list of responsibilities explicitly includes confirming that the source patient of the starting material and the final recipient are the same. This is an ATMP-specific "identity matching" requirement that ordinary pharmaceutical manufacturers do not need to perform. A wrong-patient error in cell therapy is a potentially fatal event.

blocks.zh: 比喻：參考樣品的「豁免邏輯」
blocks.en: Analogy: The "Exemption Logic" for Reference Samples

blocks.zh: Annex 19 要求每批保留參考樣品。但對自體 ATMP，整批就是一位患者的治療劑量，保留樣品意味著患者少一份藥。法規承認這個現實，允許在 CTA/MA 中說明並豁免保留，或以替代方式（例如批次記錄照片）替代。
blocks.en: Annex 19 requires reference samples to be retained for every batch. But for an autologous ATMP, the whole batch is one patient's therapeutic dose, so retaining a sample means the patient receives less product. The regulation acknowledges this reality and allows an exemption from retention, justified in the CTA/MA, or replacement by an alternative approach (for example, photographs in the batch record).

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：樣品策略設計
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Designing a Sampling Strategy

blocks.zh: 在 CTA/MA 階段與客戶及主管機關確認參考樣品/留樣策略
blocks.en: At the CTA/MA stage, confirm the reference sample/retention sample strategy with the client and the competent authority

blocks.zh: 若保留低溫樣品，確認該樣品在凍存條件下仍具代表性（無菌測試適用，但細胞活性特性不適用）
blocks.en: If a cryopreserved sample is retained, confirm that it remains representative under frozen storage conditions (applicable to sterility testing, but not to cell viability characteristics)

blocks.zh: 細胞庫 vial 不需另為參考樣品保留，但其他起始物料通常需保留 2 年
blocks.en: Cell bank vials do not need to be retained separately as reference samples, but other starting materials normally need to be retained for 2 years

blocks.zh: 解析：持續性穩定性試驗
blocks.en: Commentary: Ongoing Stability Programme

blocks.zh: Surrogate Materials（替代物料）的使用
blocks.en: Use of Surrogate Materials

blocks.zh: 自體 ATMP 因整批需給藥，無法保留樣品進行持續穩定性試驗。法規允許使用來自健康捐者的「替代物料」模擬產品行為——這是 ATMP 特有的彈性，需在 MA/CTA 中說明並論證科學合理性。
blocks.en: Because the entire batch of an autologous ATMP must be administered, samples cannot be retained for an ongoing stability programme. The regulation allows the use of "surrogate materials" from healthy donors to simulate product behaviour. This is an ATMP-specific flexibility that must be described in the MA/CTA and scientifically justified.

blocks.zh: 解凍後穩定性的處理
blocks.en: Handling of Post-Thaw Stability

blocks.zh: 解凍後穩定性（post-thaw stability）在產品開發期間完成研究即可，不需要納入持續性穩定性監控計畫。這是對現實操作困難的務實讓步。
blocks.en: Post-thaw stability only needs to be studied during product development and does not need to be included in the ongoing stability monitoring programme. This is a pragmatic concession to real operational difficulties.

blocks.zh: Chapter 6（續）— 批次放行：標準放行與分散式製造
blocks.en: Chapter 6 (continued) - Batch Release: Standard Release and Decentralised Manufacture

blocks.zh: 解析：ATMP 批次放行的倫理與法規張力
blocks.en: Commentary: The Ethical and Regulatory Tension in ATMP Batch Release

blocks.zh: AP 的放行責任：超越純分析數據
blocks.en: The AP's Release Responsibility: Beyond Analytical Data Alone

blocks.zh: ATMP 的批次認證不只看 CoA（Certificate of Analysis）。AP 必須整合：製程記錄、環境監控趨勢、工藝參數偏差、所有 OOS 事件。這要求 AP 具備更廣的判斷能力，而非單純審查分析報告。
blocks.en: Batch certification of an ATMP is not based on the CoA (Certificate of Analysis) alone. The AP must integrate process records, environmental monitoring trends, process parameter deviations and all OOS events. This requires the AP to have broader judgement, rather than simply reviewing analytical reports.

blocks.zh: 「Failed Batch + Life-Threatening」的灰色地帶
blocks.en: The Grey Area of "Failed Batch + Life-Threatening"

blocks.zh: 6.11/6.12 是法規中罕見的「倫理條款」：當 ATMP 批次不合格，但不用藥患者可能死亡時，允許醫師在充分知情後決定是否給藥。此時 AP 的責任是：清楚標示批次失敗、提供風險評估、向主管機關通報——但最終決定交給醫師，不在 GMP Annex 的管轄範疇內。
blocks.en: 6.11/6.12 are rare "ethical clauses" in the regulations: when an ATMP batch fails, but the patient may die without treatment, the physician is allowed to decide whether to administer it after being fully informed. The AP's responsibility here is to clearly label the batch as failed, provide a risk assessment, and notify the competent authority, but the final decision is left to the physician and falls outside the scope of the GMP Annex.

blocks.zh: 短效期放行的兩階段策略
blocks.en: Two-Stage Strategy for Short Shelf-Life Release

blocks.zh: 效期只有幾小時的細胞治療產品，傳統 14 天無菌測試根本無法在給藥前完成。法規允許「分階段認證」：
blocks.en: For a cell therapy product with a shelf-life of only a few hours, the conventional 14-day sterility test simply cannot be completed before administration. The regulation allows "staged certification":

blocks.zh: 第一階段：初步認證（基於製程記錄、EM 結果、已完成的快速測試）→ AP 初簽
blocks.en: Stage 1: Initial certification (based on process records, EM results and rapid tests already completed) → AP initial sign-off

blocks.zh: 第二階段：完整認證（補充最終測試結果後）→ AP 最終確認
blocks.en: Stage 2: Full certification (after the final test results are added) → AP final confirmation

blocks.zh: 此模式需主管機關批准，且必須在 SOP 中詳細描述整個程序與責任分工。
blocks.en: This model requires competent authority approval, and the entire procedure and the division of responsibilities must be described in detail in an SOP.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：短效期放行 SOP 設計要點
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Key Points for Designing a Short Shelf-Life Release SOP

blocks.zh: 明確定義哪些測試結果必須在初步認證前取得
blocks.en: Clearly define which test results must be obtained before initial certification

blocks.zh: 定義 OOS 結果出現時通知臨床人員的程序（含時間窗口）
blocks.en: Define the procedure (including the time window) for notifying clinical staff when an OOS result occurs

blocks.zh: 製程驗證數據必須足夠強健，能在測試完整性不足時作為支持依據
blocks.en: Process validation data must be robust enough to serve as supporting evidence when test completeness is insufficient

blocks.zh: 持續評估 QPS 有效性，包含趨勢分析
blocks.en: Continuously evaluate the effectiveness of the QPS, including trend analysis

blocks.zh: 解析：分散式製造的監管架構
blocks.en: Commentary: The Regulatory Framework for Decentralised Manufacture

blocks.zh: Point of Care 製造的監管邏輯
blocks.en: The Regulatory Logic of Point of Care Manufacture

blocks.zh: 部分 ATMP（特別是新鮮細胞製劑）在醫院現場製備後立即給藥，傳統「中央工廠 → 配送 → 給藥」模式不適用。PIC/S 允許分散式製造，但要求：
blocks.en: Some ATMPs (especially fresh cell preparations) are prepared at the hospital site and administered immediately, so the traditional "central factory → distribution → administration" model does not apply. PIC/S allows decentralised manufacture, but requires:

blocks.zh: 有一個「負責任基地」（responsible site）承擔整體 GMP 監管
blocks.en: A "responsible site" that bears overall GMP oversight

blocks.zh: 分散現場的放行人員受 AP 監督，不能完全獨立運作
blocks.en: Release personnel at the decentralised site are supervised by the AP and cannot operate completely independently

blocks.zh: AP 的批次認證責任不可轉讓，只能「委託」部分動作
blocks.en: The AP's batch certification responsibility cannot be transferred; only certain actions can be "delegated"

blocks.zh: 「責任不可轉讓」原則
blocks.en: The "Responsibility Cannot Be Transferred" Principle

blocks.zh: 即使在醫院現場由受訓人員操作放行，AP 仍須在合理時間內審查所有現場放行決定。若任何現場批次有問題，AP 必須能啟動回收或警示程序。
blocks.en: Even when trained personnel perform release at the hospital site, the AP must still review all site release decisions within a reasonable time. If any site batch has a problem, the AP must be able to initiate a recall or alert procedure.

blocks.zh: 比喻：連鎖餐廳的品質管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Quality Management in a Restaurant Chain

blocks.zh: 分散式製造就像連鎖餐廳：中央廚房（responsible site）提供食材規格和 SOP，各分店（decentralised sites）按程序操作。若某分店出問題，中央廚房負責調查、矯正、決定是否暫停。AP 是總公司的品質長，不在現場但負全責。
blocks.en: Decentralised manufacture is like a restaurant chain: the central kitchen (responsible site) provides ingredient specifications and SOPs, and each branch (decentralised site) operates according to the procedures. If a branch has a problem, the central kitchen is responsible for investigating, correcting and deciding whether to suspend operations. The AP is the head office's chief quality officer: not on site, but fully accountable.

blocks.zh: Chapter 7 — 外包活動（Outsourced Activities）
blocks.en: Chapter 7 - Outsourced Activities

blocks.zh: 解析：ATMP 特有的外包彈性
blocks.en: Commentary: Outsourcing Flexibility Specific to ATMPs

blocks.zh: 為何允許委外給非 GMP 認證機構？
blocks.en: Why Is Outsourcing to Non-GMP-Certified Organisations Allowed?

blocks.zh: 核型分析（karyotype testing）、外顯子組定序（exome sequencing）等高度專業的基因/染色體檢測通常由學術機構或專業臨床實驗室執行，這些機構未必持有 GMP 製造許可。法規承認此現實，允許委外，但合約委託方（ATMP 製造商或 MAH）仍負有監管責任。
blocks.en: Highly specialised genetic/chromosomal tests, such as karyotype testing and exome sequencing, are usually performed by academic institutions or specialist clinical laboratories, which do not necessarily hold a GMP manufacturing licence. The regulation acknowledges this reality and allows outsourcing, but the contract giver (the ATMP manufacturer or MAH) remains responsible for oversight.

blocks.zh: Contract Giver 的責任不轉讓
blocks.en: The Contract Giver's Responsibility Is Not Transferred

blocks.zh: 委外不代表責任轉出。ATMP 製造商必須：評估外包機構的能力→確認其 GMP 水準與風險相稱→進行適當資格確認。這與傳統原料委外的管理邏輯一致，只是允許非全 GMP 認證的情形。
blocks.en: Outsourcing does not mean transferring responsibility away. The ATMP manufacturer must: assess the contract acceptor's capability → confirm that its GMP level is commensurate with the risk → perform appropriate qualification. This follows the same management logic as outsourcing of conventional raw materials, except that it allows for cases where the acceptor is not fully GMP-certified.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：委外測試的管理
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Managing Outsourced Testing

blocks.zh: 建立合格外包實驗室清單，記錄評估依據
blocks.en: Establish a list of qualified outsourced laboratories and record the basis of the assessment

blocks.zh: 技術協議明確規定測試方法、結果回傳時效、OOS 處理程序
blocks.en: The technical agreement clearly specifies test methods, turnaround time for returning results, and OOS handling procedures

blocks.zh: 定期審核（audit）外包實驗室的品質表現
blocks.en: Periodically audit the quality performance of outsourced laboratories

blocks.zh: 確認外包測試活動不影響最終 ATMP 的品質
blocks.en: Confirm that outsourced testing activities do not affect the quality of the final ATMP

blocks.zh: Chapter 8 — 投訴與產品回收（Complaints & Product Recall）
blocks.en: Chapter 8 - Complaints & Product Recall

blocks.zh: 解析：ATMP 回收的特殊複雜性
blocks.en: Commentary: The Particular Complexity of ATMP Recall

blocks.zh: Look-back 程序：捐者資訊後追
blocks.en: The Look-Back Procedure: Tracing Back on Donor Information

blocks.zh: 傳統藥品的回收是「產品 → 市場」方向的物流問題。ATMP 增加了「捐者 → 製品 → 患者」的雙向追蹤。若捐者在採集後被診斷出傳染病，所有使用該捐者材料製備的 ATMP 都需要啟動 look-back，評估已給藥患者的風險並採取措施。
blocks.en: Recall of a conventional medicinal product is a logistics problem in the "product → market" direction. ATMPs add two-way tracing of "donor → product → patient". If a donor is diagnosed with an infectious disease after collection, look-back must be initiated for all ATMPs prepared from that donor's material, to assess the risk to patients who have already been treated and to take action.

blocks.zh: 「無法回收」的現實：自體 ATMP
blocks.en: The Reality of "Cannot Be Recalled": Autologous ATMPs

blocks.zh: 自體 ATMP 的整批已全數給藥給唯一患者，傳統意義上的產品回收無法執行。法規因此提供替代方案：向醫療人員通報質量缺陷資訊，讓醫師評估後續臨床監控需求。這是一種「風險溝通」而非「實物召回」。
blocks.en: The entire batch of an autologous ATMP has already been administered to the single patient, so a recall in the traditional sense cannot be carried out. The regulation therefore provides an alternative: notify healthcare professionals of the quality defect information so that the physician can assess the need for follow-up clinical monitoring. This is "risk communication" rather than a "physical recall".

blocks.zh: Mock Recall 的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of Mock Recall

blocks.zh: ATMP 的供應鏈涉及組織庫、CDMO、醫院等多個環節，且患者通常病情嚴重、時間緊迫。若從未演練召回，真正需要時程序混亂的後果嚴重。建議每年進行模擬演練，且要覆蓋正常上班時間與非上班時間（凌晨接到通報如何處理？）。
blocks.en: The ATMP supply chain involves multiple links, including tissue establishments, the CDMO and hospitals, and patients are usually seriously ill and time is critical. If a recall has never been rehearsed, the consequences of a chaotic procedure when it is truly needed are severe. Annual mock exercises are recommended, covering both normal working hours and out-of-hours (how is a notification received at 3 a.m. handled?).

blocks.zh: Part B — 特定產品類型（Specific Guidance on Selected Product Types）
blocks.en: Part B - Specific Guidance on Selected Product Types

blocks.zh: 解析：動物來源物料的特殊管控
blocks.en: Commentary: Special Controls for Animal-Derived Materials

blocks.zh: Xenogeneic（異種）材料的定義
blocks.en: Definition of Xenogeneic Material

blocks.zh: Xenogeneic = 來自不同物種（通常是動物）的細胞/組織。異種細胞療法（如豬胰島細胞移植）屬此類。這類產品的風險包含動物病原體跨種傳播（zoonosis），因此管控要求更嚴格，甚至需要特別法規核准。
blocks.en: Xenogeneic = cells/tissue from a different species (usually animals). Xenogeneic cell therapies (such as porcine islet cell transplantation) fall into this category. The risks of such products include cross-species transmission of animal pathogens (zoonosis), so the control requirements are stricter and may even require special regulatory approval.

blocks.zh: 屠宰場材料明確禁止
blocks.en: Slaughterhouse Material Is Explicitly Prohibited

blocks.zh: 用於異種細胞治療的動物組織不得來自屠宰場（abattoir）或野生動物。必須使用在封閉屏障設施（barrier facility）中專門飼養的動物，且其健康狀態需連續監控記錄。這是 B1 最核心的操作禁止事項。
blocks.en: Animal tissue used for xenogeneic cell therapy must not come from abattoirs or wild animals. Animals specifically bred in a closed barrier facility must be used, and their health status must be continuously monitored and recorded. This is the most central operational prohibition in B1.

blocks.zh: OIE 疾病監控的實際應用
blocks.en: Practical Application of OIE Disease Surveillance

blocks.zh: 世界動物衛生組織（OIE）定期發布各國動物疾病疫情報告。ATMP 製造商必須訂閱並追蹤相關報告——如果供應國爆發人畜共通傳染病（如口蹄疫、禽流感），可能影響動物來源物料的使用決策。
blocks.en: The World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) regularly publishes animal disease outbreak reports for each country. ATMP manufacturers must subscribe to and track the relevant reports: if a zoonotic disease (such as foot-and-mouth disease or avian influenza) breaks out in the supplying country, it may affect decisions on the use of animal-derived materials.

blocks.zh: 解析：基因治療產品的製造要點
blocks.en: Commentary: Key Manufacturing Points for Gene Therapy Products

blocks.zh: GTMP 的製造鏈複雜性
blocks.en: The Complexity of the GTMP Manufacturing Chain

blocks.zh: 基因治療產品的製造通常分三層：
blocks.en: Manufacture of gene therapy products is usually divided into three tiers:

blocks.zh: 質粒製備（Plasmid Production）
blocks.en: Plasmid Production

blocks.zh: 病毒載體生產（Viral Vector Mfg）
blocks.en: Viral Vector Manufacture

blocks.zh: 細胞轉導 / 成品製備（DP）
blocks.en: Cell Transduction / Finished Product Preparation (DP)

blocks.zh: 每一層都有各自的 GMP 要求深度，法規允許早期階段（質粒、載體）適用「GMP 原則」而非完整 GMP。
blocks.en: Each tier has its own depth of GMP requirements, and the regulation allows the early stages (plasmid, vector) to follow "GMP principles" rather than full GMP.

blocks.zh: 「GMP Principles」vs. 完整 GMP
blocks.en: "GMP Principles" vs. Full GMP

blocks.zh: 病毒載體製備若非最終產品，各國法規可能不要求完整 GMP 許可。但 Annex 2A 要求：製造商仍須確保過程控制、異常調查、變更控制的核心 GMP 元素到位。這個灰色地帶需要製造商主動風險評估並文件化。
blocks.en: If viral vector preparation is not the final product, national regulations may not require a full GMP licence. However, Annex 2A requires that the manufacturer still ensure the core GMP elements of process control, deviation investigation and change control are in place. This grey area requires the manufacturer to carry out a proactive risk assessment and document it.

blocks.zh: 生物安全等級（BSL）的影響
blocks.en: The Impact of Biosafety Level (BSL)

blocks.zh: 能複製的病毒載體（replication-competent）BSL 等級高於不能複製的（replication-incompetent）。BSL 等級決定廠房設計（負壓、廢氣過濾）、人員防護、廢棄物處理要求。CDMO 在評估 GTMP 項目前必須確認設施 BSL 許可範圍。
blocks.en: Replication-competent viral vectors require a higher BSL than replication-incompetent ones. The BSL determines facility design (negative pressure, exhaust air filtration), personnel protection and waste handling requirements. Before evaluating a GTMP project, a CDMO must confirm the BSL licence scope of its facility.

blocks.zh: CDMO 接收 GTMP 項目的查核清單
blocks.en: Checklist for a CDMO Accepting a GTMP Project

blocks.zh: 確認病毒載體類型及 BSL 等級，對照本廠設施許可
blocks.en: Confirm the viral vector type and BSL level, and check them against the facility's licence

blocks.zh: 要求客戶提供載體製造商的供應商資格文件
blocks.en: Ask the client to provide the vector manufacturer's supplier qualification documents

blocks.zh: 確認質粒 → 載體 → 成品的可追溯性文件設計
blocks.en: Confirm the design of traceability documentation for plasmid → vector → finished product

blocks.zh: 若載體委外，審查技術協議涵蓋的 GMP 要求範圍
blocks.en: If the vector is outsourced, review the scope of GMP requirements covered by the technical agreement

blocks.zh: 評估員工生物安全培訓需求
blocks.en: Assess staff biosafety training needs

blocks.zh: 解析：細胞療法、組織工程與複合型 ATMP
blocks.en: Commentary: Cell Therapy, Tissue Engineering and Combined ATMPs

blocks.zh: Scaffold（支架）的 GMP 地位
blocks.en: The GMP Status of the Scaffold

blocks.zh: 組織工程產品的 scaffold 可能是醫療器材（Medical Device）或生物材料。法規要求優先使用已獲授權的 scaffold 產品。若需要客製化支架，必須與裝置供應商簽訂品質協議，明確雙方在 GMP 符合性上的責任。
blocks.en: The scaffold of a tissue-engineered product may be a medical device or a biomaterial. The regulation requires preference for scaffold products that are already authorised. If a customised scaffold is needed, a quality agreement must be signed with the device supplier, clearly defining each party's responsibility for GMP compliance.

blocks.zh: Combined ATMP 的監管交叉
blocks.en: Regulatory Overlap of Combined ATMPs

blocks.zh: Combined ATMP 同時涉及藥品（ATMP 細胞部分）和醫療器材（整合裝置）的監管。製造商必須同時符合兩套要求，並在技術文件中清楚說明各部分的符合性路徑。
blocks.en: A combined ATMP is regulated both as a medicinal product (the ATMP cell part) and as a medical device (the integrated device). The manufacturer must comply with both sets of requirements and clearly explain the compliance pathway for each part in the technical documentation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：客製化裝置的品質協議
blocks.en: Analogy: The Quality Agreement for a Customised Device

blocks.zh: 若 scaffold 是根據患者解剖結構客製的 3D 列印支架，它是「客製醫療器材」，沒有標準產品規格可參照。品質協議需要定義：每批 scaffold 的驗收標準是什麼、如何確保批次間一致性、不良事件如何通報。這類產品的 QA 管理需要跨領域協作。
blocks.en: If a scaffold is a 3D-printed scaffold customised to the patient's anatomy, it is a "custom-made medical device" with no standard product specification to refer to. The quality agreement needs to define: what the acceptance criteria are for each scaffold batch, how batch-to-batch consistency is ensured, and how adverse events are reported. QA management of such products requires cross-disciplinary collaboration.

blocks.zh: 術語彙編（Common Glossary to Annex 2A and 2B）
blocks.en: Glossary (Common Glossary to Annex 2A and 2B)

blocks.zh: 術語解析：CDMO 操作情境應用
blocks.en: Glossary Commentary: Application in CDMO Scenarios

blocks.zh: MCB / WCB / WVS 系統——CDMO 的實際意義
blocks.en: The MCB / WCB / WVS System: What It Means in Practice for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 當客戶帶來 ATMP 項目，最早需要確認的問題之一就是：「你的 MCB/WCB 建立了嗎？」
blocks.en: When a client brings an ATMP project, one of the first questions to confirm is: "Have your MCB/WCB been established?"

blocks.zh: MCB 尚未建立：CDMO 可能需要協助客戶進行 MCB 建立，這屬於 GMP 範圍內的高度關鍵活動
blocks.en: MCB not yet established: The CDMO may need to help the client establish the MCB, which is a highly critical activity within the scope of GMP

blocks.zh: MCB 已建立，在其他廠：需要技術移轉協議，確認 MCB 特性資料完整
blocks.en: MCB established, at another site: A technology transfer agreement is needed, and the completeness of the MCB characterisation data must be confirmed

blocks.zh: WCB 是生產用細胞庫：每批生產使用 WCB 而非 MCB，確保 MCB 的完整性
blocks.en: The WCB is the production cell bank: Each production batch uses the WCB rather than the MCB, to protect the integrity of the MCB

blocks.zh: Vector 與 Viral Vector 的層級關係
blocks.en: The Hierarchy Between Vector and Viral Vector

blocks.zh: Vector 是廣義傳遞工具（包括質粒、脂質體、病毒）；Viral vector 是特指病毒來源的版本。臨床上常用的 viral vector 類型：
blocks.en: A vector is a broad term for a delivery tool (including plasmids, liposomes and viruses); a viral vector specifically refers to the virus-derived version. Commonly used clinical viral vector types:

blocks.zh: Lentivirus：可整合至基因組，用於 CAR-T 等
blocks.en: Lentivirus: Can integrate into the genome; used for CAR-T and others

blocks.zh: AAV（腺相關病毒）：多為 replication-incompetent，安全性高
blocks.en: AAV (adeno-associated virus): Mostly replication-incompetent, with a high safety profile

blocks.zh: Adenovirus：不整合，瞬時表現
blocks.en: Adenovirus: Does not integrate; transient expression

blocks.zh: CDMO 的設施 BSL 許可決定了可接收哪些 viral vector 類型。
blocks.en: The BSL licence of a CDMO's facility determines which viral vector types it can accept.

blocks.zh: Scaffold 的法規身份可能是原料、醫療器材、或兩者的組合，取決於其在產品中的作用方式。若 scaffold 是 combined ATMP 的「不可分割組成部分」，則整個產品按 combined ATMP 監管，scaffold 部分需同時符合醫療器材要求。這影響 CDMO 如何設計供應商管理和品質協議。
blocks.en: The regulatory identity of a scaffold may be a raw material, a medical device, or a combination of the two, depending on how it acts in the product. If the scaffold is an "integral part" of a combined ATMP, the whole product is regulated as a combined ATMP, and the scaffold part must also meet medical device requirements. This affects how a CDMO designs its supplier management and quality agreements.

blocks.zh: SPF 動物與 Barrier Facility
blocks.en: SPF Animals and Barrier Facilities

blocks.zh: SPF（無特定病原體）動物就像「潔淨室中的動物」。它們生活在封閉環境，飼養人員不接觸外界動物群體。製造商必須持有這些動物健康監測的記錄，且可隨時供主管機關查驗。這是生物製藥最基本的生物安全控制之一。
blocks.en: SPF (specific pathogen free) animals are like "animals in a cleanroom". They live in a closed environment, and the animal handlers have no contact with outside animal populations. The manufacturer must hold health monitoring records for these animals and be able to make them available to the competent authority at any time. This is one of the most basic biosafety controls in biopharmaceutical manufacture.

blocks.zh: QTPP vs. CQA vs. CPP：三者關係
blocks.en: QTPP vs. CQA vs. CPP: How the Three Relate

blocks.zh: 這三個 ICH Q8R2 術語構成 ATMP 品質管理的邏輯架構：
blocks.en: These three ICH Q8(R2) terms form the logical framework of ATMP quality management:

blocks.zh: QTPP：「我希望這個藥品達到什麼品質標準？」（目標設定）
blocks.en: QTPP: "What quality standard do I want this medicinal product to achieve?" (target setting)

blocks.zh: CQA：「哪些品質屬性決定了是否達到 QTPP？」（關鍵特性）
blocks.en: CQA: "Which quality attributes determine whether the QTPP is achieved?" (critical characteristics)

blocks.zh: CPP：「哪些製程參數影響 CQA？」（製程控制點）
blocks.en: CPP: "Which process parameters affect the CQAs?" (process control points)

blocks.zh: ATMP 的 QTPP 必須在 MA/CTA 中定義，並指導整個控制策略設計。
blocks.en: The QTPP of an ATMP must be defined in the MA/CTA and guides the design of the entire control strategy.

blocks.zh: Zoonosis 風險與 CDMO 的實際影響
blocks.en: Zoonosis Risk and Its Practical Impact on a CDMO

blocks.zh: 異種材料的 zoonosis 風險是監管機關的高度關注點。CDMO 接收含動物來源材料的 ATMP 項目時，需要評估：
blocks.en: The zoonosis risk of xenogeneic material is a major concern for regulators. When a CDMO accepts an ATMP project containing animal-derived material, it needs to assess:

blocks.zh: 動物健康監控記錄的完整性
blocks.en: Completeness of animal health monitoring records

blocks.zh: 動物相關病原體（豬內源性反轉錄病毒 PERV 等）的病毒清除驗證
blocks.en: Viral clearance validation for animal-related pathogens (such as porcine endogenous retrovirus, PERV)

blocks.zh: 員工個人防護與健康監控計畫
blocks.en: Personal protection and health monitoring programme for employees

blocks.zh: 廢棄物的特殊處置要求（GMO 含有的生物廢棄物）
blocks.en: Special disposal requirements for waste (biological waste containing GMOs)

blocks.zh: Somatic Cells 的三種來源類型
blocks.en: The Three Source Types of Somatic Cells

blocks.zh: 三種類型的 GMP 要求、可追溯性深度、免疫考量各不相同，CDMO 在接案前必須明確確認。
blocks.en: The three types differ in GMP requirements, depth of traceability and immunological considerations, so a CDMO must clearly confirm which applies before accepting a project.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: QC 的核心挑戰：ATMP 因樣品稀缺、效期短、自體產品的獨特性，傳統 QC 要求（參考樣品、留樣、穩定性測試）均有對應的科學合理豁免路徑，需在 CTA/MA 中事先規劃並獲得主管機關同意。
blocks.en: Core QC challenges: Because of scarce samples, short shelf-life and the uniqueness of autologous products, each conventional QC requirement (reference samples, retention samples, stability testing) has a corresponding scientifically justified exemption pathway, which must be planned in advance in the CTA/MA and agreed with the competent authority.

blocks.zh: 短效期放行：兩階段批次認證（initial + final certification）是 ATMP 的重要創新機制，允許 AP 在測試完整結果取得前初步放行，前提是有強健的製程驗證數據和完整的 SOP 支撐。
blocks.en: Short shelf-life release: Two-stage batch certification (initial + final certification) is an important innovative mechanism for ATMPs, allowing the AP to give initial release before the complete test results are available, provided that robust process validation data and a complete supporting SOP are in place.

blocks.zh: 分散式製造：Point-of-care 模式的核心是「responsible site」概念——AP 的認證責任不可轉讓，但可建立監督框架讓分散現場在特定情境下代為放行，AP 事後審查。
blocks.en: Decentralised manufacture: The core of the point-of-care model is the "responsible site" concept: the AP's certification responsibility cannot be transferred, but a supervision framework can be set up so that decentralised sites release on the AP's behalf in specific circumstances, with the AP reviewing afterwards.

blocks.zh: Look-back 程序：捐者來源資訊在採集後仍可影響已製備或已給藥的 ATMP，製造商必須有完整的雙向追蹤能力和相應的風險評估/通報機制。
blocks.en: Look-back procedure: Donor source information can still affect ATMPs already prepared or administered after collection, so the manufacturer must have full two-way traceability and a corresponding risk assessment/notification mechanism.

blocks.zh: Part B 特定類型：動物來源材料需 OIE 疾病監控 + 屠宰場材料禁用；GTMP 需釐清 GMP vs. GMP Principles 的適用範圍；細胞/組織工程產品強調 scaffold 的供應商品質協議；combined ATMP 需同時符合藥品和器材監管。
blocks.en: Part B specific types: Animal-derived material requires OIE disease surveillance plus a ban on slaughterhouse material; for GTMPs, the scope of application of GMP vs. GMP principles must be clarified; cell/tissue-engineered products emphasise a supplier quality agreement for the scaffold; combined ATMPs must comply with both medicinal product and device regulation.

blocks.zh: 術語應用：MCB/WCB 兩層架構、viral vector 的複製能力分類、somatic cells 的三種來源、QTPP/CQA/CPP 的邏輯關係——這些是 CDMO 在接收 ATMP 項目時評估可行性的基礎語言。
blocks.en: Application of terminology: The two-tier MCB/WCB structure, the replication-capability classification of viral vectors, the three source types of somatic cells, and the logic of QTPP/CQA/CPP: this is the basic language a CDMO uses to assess feasibility when accepting an ATMP project.
